why: The student is right that the 100-move values are only estimates, but the main claim is that starting at page 3 would change the ranks, which is the StartPageMatters misconception: the long-run ranks of the random-surfer chain are the same whatever page it starts from.

concepts.why: Correctly says that visit fractions from a short simulation only estimate the ranks, but gives no further reasoning.
The answer says nothing about repeated matrix multiplication.

concepts.quote: But starting at page 3 would change the ranks.
concepts.why: Holds the wrong rule that the ranks depend on the start page; the chain mixes, so the long-run probabilities are the same from any start.
